‘𝗣𝗲𝗼𝗽𝗹𝗲 𝗣𝗼𝘄𝗲𝗿 𝘃𝘀. 𝗗𝘂𝘁𝗲𝗿𝘁𝗲’𝘀 𝗘𝗝𝗞𝘀’—𝗔𝗸𝗯𝗮𝘆𝗮𝗻 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗱𝘀 𝗥𝗮𝗹𝗹𝘆 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗝𝘂𝘀𝘁𝗶𝗰𝗲, 𝗗𝗲𝗺𝗮𝗻𝗱𝘀 𝗗𝘂𝘁𝗲𝗿𝘁𝗲’𝘀 𝗖𝗼𝗻𝘃𝗶𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻

With the backdrop of the International Criminal Court (ICC) confirming the charges against former President Rodrigo Duterte, Akbayan Partylist, together with Simbahan at Komunidad Laban sa Katiwalian (SIKLAB), and the families of those slain in the 'War on Drugs' converged at the Scout Circle today to issue a clear demand: convict the mastermind of the killings. Invoking the spirit of the People Power uprising that toppled Marcos Sr’s dictator dictatorship, the coalition declared that the same collective courage must now prevail against impunity.

Akbayan Party President Rafaela David manifested that the power of the people that brought back democracy, can also claim justice for Filipinos: “From EDSA to the ICC, the call is clear: an end to the culture of state-sponsored violence against the Filipino people. We have already won over the murderous Marcos regime four decades ago. Now, we will claim justice against Duterte and his bloody war on the poor.” 

“Justice demands conviction. Duterte must pay for his brutal crimes against the Filipino people. Only then can we start to break the cycle of violence, when people claim accountability for the abuses even of their topmost leaders,” she added
